page.title: Edit reading test
page.statusLabel: Custom editor for reading tests. Status:

fields.title: Title
fields.publishStateHelp: Choose whether the reading test stays as a draft or can be opened through a share link. Library publishing comes later.
fields.feedbackModeHelp: This is configuration for generated guidance and preferred display mode. It does not fully change the teacher flow by itself yet.

flow.title: Timer
flow.description: Choose the time for the reading test. When the test is submitted, the actual time used is shown and used to calculate words read per minute. If time runs out, the test ends automatically and is sent for assessment.
flow.showQuestionsAfterReadingHelp: The student reads first and gets the tasks afterwards.

cover.title: Choose publishing image
cover.description: The reading test does not use an image inside the test, but it needs a 16:9 image for the publishing view.

taskTypes.enabledDescription: These are the task types this reading test is intended to use. The student page can later decide how each type is shown.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.shortAnswerHelp: Short written answer from the student.

saveBar.title: Save to My content
saveBar.description: Saves text, tasks, timer, and selected template image.

defaults.title: Reading test
defaults.fillInWordPrompt: Choose the correct word for the blank.
defaults.fillInWordSentence: The children saw a black _____ that said meow.

errors.noAccess: You do not have access to this reading test.
errors.notReadingTest: This lesson is not a reading test.
errors.timerTooShort: The timer must be at least 10 seconds.
